findings.finding: Height feedback and horizontal feedback can have different availability; capture cadence must stay distinct from physics cadence.
findings.relevance: AL-020 held altitude commands did not prevent early contact in long outages
findings.direction_alignment: Improve physics-based controller testing and provide an inspectable working demo
findings.opportunity_or_risk: A synthetic fresh channel can isolate availability effects but does not model a real sensor or fusion estimator
findings.engineering_cost: Masked 50 Hz captures, strict reconstruction, 24 fresh flights, paired 3D demonstration
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-021 separates horizontal and altitude feedback availability before descent changes
findings.verification_needed: Freeze both axis choices and existing gates; preserve exact inactive traces and all failures

overall_recommendation: Run the bounded availability ablation with unchanged controller, predictor and physics.
evidence_gaps: Ideal synthetic captures do not validate a real sensor or fused estimate
All six final seeds were previously tested
Ideal attitude/contact supervision and independent yaw refinement remain unresolved
